title: Gaussian weights on fractals and Edelman's ghosts and shadows
summary: Can a Gaussian on a noninteger-dimensional fractal give a probabilistic realization of Edelman's ghosts and shadows? We distinguish a Gaussian-weighted Hausdorff measure, a radial Gaussian law, and a Gaussian random vector or field. For every real $\beta>1$, we construct a closed cone of Hausdorff dimension $\beta$ whose Gaussian-weighted $\beta$-dimensional Hausdorff measure has exactly the $\chi_\beta$ radial distribution.
